subject: prd/plan-new
statement: When emitting a task in a plan/v2 plan for `/implement-now`, the planner shall record a complete vendor-neutral execution demand containing the closed `reasoning`, `coupling`, `novelty`, `verification`, `impact_scope`, and `architectural_role` assessment, resolvable evidence citations supporting those values, the mechanically derived `capability`, `deliberation`, `context`, and `assurance` minimums, the derivation-policy version, and any evidence-backed planner assurance raise; every executable task, including a mechanical-flagged task, shall carry this model-backed demand.
rationale: the planning session owns task semantics; native model/effort selection belongs to the selected harness adapter
fit_criterion: every plan/v2 and dogfood task carries all six assessment axes, all four profile components, supporting citations, a policy version, and any raise evidence; mechanical fixtures carry complete demand; none reaches checkpoint/freeze absent or partial
